title: Reject attacker-writable lichend configuration even without embedded secrets
description: Security review finding in rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs: Config::from_file only enforces owner/mode after detecting gateway PSK fields. A group/world-writable secret-free config can still redirect security.rollback_floor_root, mesh interfaces, or other privileged daemon behavior. Always verify ownership and reject group/other write bits; additionally require 0600-style privacy when embedded secrets are present.
close_reason: Verified: verify_config_metadata runs pre-parse unconditionally (reject group/other write; Linux owner check) and post-parse adds 0600-style privacy for secret-bearing configs. Mandated scenarios already tested; added missing 0o640 secret-free boundary pin (accepted). 10/10 pass. Ownership check stays Linux-only by design (libc dep).
